title: Animator
summary: The animation player inside a Humanoid: LoadAnimation(animation) returns an AnimationTrack you Play/Stop, with priority, speed adjustment, weight fading, and events.

methods.name: LoadAnimation
methods.description: Loads the animation asset into a track. Errors if the asset can't be used by this experience.

details.heading: AnimationTrack essentials
details.body: `Play(fadeTime?, weight?, speed?)`, `Stop(fadeTime?)`, `AdjustSpeed(speed)`, `TimePosition`, `Length`, `Looped`, `Priority` (Enum.AnimationPriority: Idle/Movement/Action/Action2/Action3/Action4 — higher overrides lower), events: `Stopped`, `Played`, `KeyframeReached`, `MarkerReached`.

details.heading: Where Animator lives
details.body: As a child of the Humanoid: character.Humanoid.Animator. (Humanoid:LoadAnimation still exists but Animator is the modern path.)

explanation.whatItIs: The character's animation deck: load cassettes (Animation), get tracks, play/blend/stop them with priorities.
explanation.whyItExists: Characters layer many animations — walking + waving + facial. Animator manages playback and priority blending.
whenToUse: Abilities and emotes: load once, play on demand
whenNotToUse: Re-loading the same animation every play — load once and reuse the track
Server-only contexts where the character isn't streamed appropriately
tips: Cache tracks per character: loading is relatively expensive
Set Priority so attacks override walks (Action > Movement)
KeyframeReached syncs effects (footsteps, swings) to exact frames
commonMistakes: LoadAnimation errors because the animation asset isn't owned by the experience
Playing on the client only — other players don't see it; animate on the server or replicate intent

examples.title: Play an emote with priority
examples.code:
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

local wave = Instance.new("Animation")
wave.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507770239"

local track = animator:LoadAnimation(wave)
track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
track.Looped = false

local function playWave()
    track:Play(0.2)   -- 0.2s fade in
end
